'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Paul Bansal LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Paul Bansal]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''More Pews Than Church'''; username DarkBro. Handwritten. Sheet lists Home One: War Room before Communing (objective). Lines 37–38 Slight Weapon Malfunction → Slight Weapons Malfunction. Shield 6 scribbled then Yavin Sentry (V).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Communing]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
